_comment: Installed to /etc/pbs-group-retention.json on infer-tier0 (VM704). Groups listed here are pruned to their newest keep_last snapshots at 07:05 UTC, after the store-wide job prune-tier0 (keep-last 3, keep-weekly 1, 07:00). keep_last may not be below 2. PBS #2 is the SECOND copy: PBS #1 on 0own keeps the longer history.

groups.why: docker host VM100 (~390 containers): 22-50 GB of unique data per snapshot, the biggest group on the datastore. FROZEN since 2026-10-19: its VM-level backup is paused (the host is backed up file by file as 0docker:host/dockerhost-state); remove frozen if the VM job runs again
pg-primary VM100: 34-45 GB of unique data per snapshot; a physical replica also runs on 0infer. FROZEN since 2026-10-21: the 0database fleet (pve01) is being sunset, VM100 is off
